checks.criterion: Product photos retain their original colors on the public storefront
checks.name: storefront-images-are-colored
checks.evidence: On localhost and again on the public preview URL (https://kaos-bani-preorder.preview.emergentagent.com), all elements on the storefront (hero shirt images, catalog cards) plus getByTestId('selected-product-image') return computed getComputedStyle(el).filter === 'none'. Source inspection confirms frontend/src/index.css has a global 'img { filter: none !important; }' rule overriding the Tailwind 'grayscale' utility class still present in markup.

checks.criterion: Product photo remains colored after adding an item to the cart
checks.name: cart-item-image-colored
checks.evidence: Added the built-in shirt via getByTestId('add-to-cart-button'), cart-count-badge became '1', the img inside [data-testid^="cart-item-"] has computed filter === 'none' despite the 'grayscale' Tailwind class in its className, neutralized by the same global CSS override.

checks.criterion: Uploaded image previews remain colored in the admin dashboard
checks.name: admin-uploaded-images-colored
checks.evidence: Logged in via /admin with PIN 492345 (admin-pin-input + admin-login-submit), admin-page visible, admin-images-section visible with 4 variant thumbnails; every img within it returns computed filter === 'none'.

notes: Ran backend pytest suite (8 passed, unaffected by this UI-only criteria) as a sanity check. All 3 matrix criteria are purely visual/UI, verified with browser checks only; no new backend test files needed. Confirmed via source read (frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx, AdminProducts.tsx, Admin.tsx) that the Tailwind 'grayscale' class is still literally present on several tags, but frontend/src/index.css:132 enforces 'filter: none !important' globally on img elements, so no grayscale rendering reaches the user anywhere in the app - storefront, cart, or admin. No fixture rows created; this was a read-only style verification plus a local, un-submitted cart interaction as instructed.
